ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A certain scientific research vessel set out from Shanghai to conduct an investigation of the sea areas of the Southern Hemisphere. Read the hemispheric projection map centered on the South Pole and answer the following questions. <image1> When the pole shadow at place N shrinks to a point, what is the sunrise direction at place M?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a hemispheric projection map centered on the South Pole S, the outer circle represents the boundary of the Southern Hemisphere, and the figure is marked with the 180° meridian and the 150° meridian. Point M is located near the 180° meridian, and point N is located near the 150° meridian; from the figure it can be seen that M and N are roughly on the same latitude circle and are both located in the Southern Hemisphere. Then reason: the pole shadow at place N shrinks to a point, indicating that the noon solar altitude at place N is 90°, that is, the sun shines directly on place N. Since M and N are located on the same latitude, the latitude of the direct solar point at this time is also the latitude where M is located, and the direct solar point is in the Southern Hemisphere. When the direct solar point on the earth is located in the Southern Hemisphere, except in polar day and polar night areas, the sunrise direction is inclined toward the southeast. Therefore, the sunrise direction at place M is southeast.

raw_record.question_text:
A certain scientific research vessel set out from Shanghai to conduct an investigation of the sea areas of the Southern Hemisphere. Read the hemispheric projection map centered on the South Pole and answer the following questions.

<image1>

When the pole shadow at place N shrinks to a point, what is the sunrise direction at place M?

method.method_draft: 先读图：该图为以南极点 S 为中心的半球投影，M、N 都位于南半球，且从图中可见 M 与 N 在同一条纬线圈上，N 在约150°经线附近，M 在180°经线附近。再读题：‘N地的杆影缩小为点’表示N地正午太阳高度为90°，即太阳直射N地。因为M与N同纬度，所以此时太阳直射纬度也就是M所在纬度，即太阳直射南半球。运用地理规律：太阳直射点在南半球时，除极昼极夜区外，各地太阳从东偏南方向升起、西偏南方向落下。因此M地日出方向为东南。

raw_record.original_question:
某科学考察船从上海出发，对南半球海域进行考察。读以南极点为中心的半球投影图，回答下列问题。

<image1>

当N地的杆影缩小为点时，M地的日出方向是什么？
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: the figure is a hemispheric projection map centered on the South Pole S, the outer circle represents the boundary of the Southern Hemisphere, and the figure is marked with the 180° meridian and the 150° meridian. Point M is located near the 180° meridian, and point N is located near the 150° meridian; from the figure it can be seen that M and N are roughly on the same latitude circle and are both located in the Southern Hemisphere.

Then reason: the pole shadow at place N shrinks to a point, indicating that the noon solar altitude at place N is 90°, that is, the sun shines directly on place N. Since M and N are located on the same latitude, the latitude of the direct solar point at this time is also the latitude where M is located, and the direct solar point is in the Southern Hemisphere. When the direct solar point on the earth is located in the Southern Hemisphere, except in polar day and polar night areas, the sunrise direction is inclined toward the southeast. Therefore, the sunrise direction at place M is southeast.
